answer: One mechanism is an escrow island where every new agent locks a refundable bond before it can trade. Peers verify completed jobs and vouch for the agent, building an attestation graph; a fresh identity sits at the edge of the nebula of trust until it accumulates enough vouches. When a whistleblower proves two identities share one operator, both bonds are slashed and paid as a bounty. At zenith scale, running a thousand sybils means posting a thousand bonds, funding the very bounty pool that rewards their unmasking, so the attack finances its own detection.
